messages.author: 025c39520db1fe6d
messages.subject: Old INLA versions?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm just wondering whether anyone has old binaries of INLA around. Specifically, I'm looking for anything from before November 2014. There's a thread on this list from 2013 that mentions http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/binaries/testing/Old/ , but it doesn't look like there are old versions available there currently.

Just in case no old binaries are available and I need to build an old version myself, would it be sufficient to add an 'hg checkout' command to the makefile in the Linux build package, or might I also need to replace taucs, metis etc. with older versions?

Thanks!
Anand Patil
